newsitem.title: DUBAI: Abu Dhabi oil refinery set for maintenance - trade.
newsitem.headline: Abu Dhabi oil refinery set for maintenance - trade.

text.p: The 60,000 barrels per day (bpd) Umm al Nar oil refinery in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates (UAE), will be shut for three weeks from mid November to carry out scheduled maintenance work, Gulf traders said on Thursday.
Umm al Nar supplies products to the UAE market unlike the emirate's main 135,000 bpd Ruwais refinery which mainly exports its products to Indian subcontinent, Gulf and Asian markets.
"Umm al Nar is down for three weeks from the middle of November," one Gulf trader said.
Refinery operations are Ruwais are running normally, Gulf traders said.
Traders had expected work to be undertaken at Ruwais' crude distillation unit in November though this has been delayed.
